desc: Build sieve up to 10^6, compute omega (distinct prime factor count) for each m, collect those with omega(m)==2.
Square collected m values to form the valid list of 400 numbers (all <= 10^12).
Answer each query using math.isqrt(A) + bisect_right for the largest valid m <= isqrt(A), output m*m.
Optimize I/O for Q <= 2e5 and verify against sample (404->400, 36->36, 123456789->123454321, 10^12->10^12) and boundary A=36.
